:root{color-scheme:light}html,body{margin:0;padding:0;width:100%;height:100%;overflow:hidden;background:#F6F1E7}#ac-screen{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100vh;height:100dvh;border:0;display:block;background:#F6F1E7}#ac-loading{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10;background:#F6F1E7;color:#344515;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font:600 13px Arial,sans-serif;letter-spacing:.06em;transition:opacity .22s;pointer-events:none}#ac-loading.hidden{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}#ac-loading span{padding:16px 24px;border:1px solid #D2D6C4;border-radius:100px}#ac-screen:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #8E9E20;outline-offset:-3px}
</style><style id="ac-loading-enhancement">
/* Loading AC: símbolo original, transição curta, feedback não decorativo */
#ac-loading{background:#F6F1E7;opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity .45s ease,visibility .45s ease;z-index:100;pointer-events:none}
#ac-loading.hidden{opacity:0;visibility:hidden}
.ac-loading-inner{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:27px;width:min(240px,60vw)}
.ac-loading-symbol{width:clamp(112px,18vw,158px);height:auto;color:#344515;overflow:visible;transform-origin:center;animation:ac-logo-appear .85s cubic-bezier(.2,.7,.15,1) both,ac-logo-breathe 2.2s 1s ease-in-out infinite}
.ac-loading-line{height:2px;width:88px;max-width:100%;background:rgba(52,69,21,.13);overflow:hidden;border-radius:9px}
.ac-loading-line i{display:block;height:100%;width:42%;background:#344515;border-radius:9px;animation:ac-line-move 1.35s ease-in-out infinite}
@keyframes ac-logo-appear{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px) scale(.96)}to{opacity:1;transform:translateY(0) scale(1)}}
@keyframes ac-logo-breathe{0%,100%{opacity:1;transform:scale(1)}50%{opacity:.76;transform:scale(.985)}}
@keyframes ac-line-move{0%{transform:translateX(-115%)}100%{transform:translateX(340%)}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ac-loading-symbol,.ac-loading-line i{animation:none!important}#ac-loading{transition:none!important}}
</style><style id="ac-documentary-overlay-css">
#ac-doc-dialog{border:0;background:#111710;color:#fff;padding:0;width:min(960px,calc(100vw - 28px));max-width:960px;max-height:calc(100dvh - 28px);border-radius:8px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 18px 60px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
#ac-doc-dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(5,8,5,.88)}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-bar{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding:13px 16px;gap:12px;font:600 13px/1.3 Arial,sans-serif}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-close{background:transparent;color:white;border:1px solid #778070;border-radius:100px;padding:9px 13px;font:600 12px Arial,sans-serif;cursor:pointer}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-player{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#000;position:relative}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-player iframe{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;border:0}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-help{margin:0;padding:12px 16px 16px;color:#d5daca;font:12px/1.5 Arial,sans-serif;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between}
#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-help a{color:#e1f0b7;text-underline-offset:3px}
@media(max-width:640px){#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-bar{padding:10px 12px}#ac-doc-dialog .ac-doc-help{padding:10px 12px}}
</style></head><body>
